_comment: Each step of the Zero Trust Assessment results kit, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls whose statements it supports and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators Book 13, Appendix A lists for them (CA-2 to KSI-PIY-RIS; CA-7 to KSI-MLA-EVC; CM-6 to KSI-CMT-LMC, KSI-CMT-RMV, KSI-MLA-EVC and KSI-SVC-ACM; AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM; AU-9(3) to KSI-SVC-VRI; none listed for CA-5 or RA-7). KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with what its providers report against them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides. 'packages' lists the steps a package's evidence must hold before the ISSO accepts it.

CA-2.title: Control Assessments
CA-2.part: assess the controls and report the results

CA-5.title: Plan of Action and Milestones
CA-5.part: document planned remediation of weaknesses; update it from assessments and continuous monitoring

CA-7.title: Continuous Monitoring
CA-7.part: ongoing assessments; correlation and analysis; response actions; reporting

CM-6.title: Configuration Settings
CM-6.part: monitor and control changes to configuration settings; approve and document deviations

RA-7.title: Risk Response
RA-7.part: respond to findings from assessments and monitoring in line with risk tolerance

AU-9.title: Protection of Audit Information
AU-9.part: protect audit information from unauthorized modification and deletion

ksis.KSI-PIY-RIS: Book 13, Appendix A's KSI for CA-2
ksis.KSI-MLA-EVC: Evaluating Configurations (Book 13, Appendix A's KSI for CA-7 and CM-6)
ksis.KSI-SVC-ACM: Book 13, Appendix A's KSI for CM-6 (configuration management automated and reviewed for drift)
ksis.KSI-CMT-RMV: Book 13, Appendix A's KSI for CM-6
ksis.KSI-MLA-OSM: Book 13, Appendix A's KSI for AU-9
ksis.KSI-SVC-VRI: Book 13, Appendix A's KSI for AU-9(3), cryptographic protection of audit information

NORMALIZE.title: Normalize every Zero Trust Assessment result to Book 11's taxonomy

REGISTER.title: Write the closure register: one entry per finding, routed and weighed

COMPARE.title: Compare two runs: new, fixed, regressed, still open, no longer evaluated

EVIDENCE.title: Record the run as timestamped, hashed, chained evidence
